title: Classify feedback with an uncertainty bucket
goal: Create a small labelled feedback set and inspect false positives.
explanation: Sentiment is not the same as topic or urgency. A short review can contain praise and criticism at once; forcing it into a single emotional label hides information. Define an explicit Mixed/Unclear route and quote the relevant text instead of guessing a customer’s feelings.
sampleInput: r1: “Arrived early. Excellent.” r2: “It is a mug.” r3: “The handle broke immediately.” r4: “Looks lovely, but the lid leaks.” r5: “Great, another week waiting.” Labels: Positive, Neutral, Negative, Mixed/Unclear.
prompt: Classify each review by ID using the defined labels. Give an exact evidence span and a separate issue/topic field. Use Mixed/Unclear when praise and criticism coexist or sarcasm is uncertain. Do not infer a person’s mood or intent beyond the text.
workedExample: r1 → Positive; r2 → Neutral; r3 → Negative, issue handle durability; r4 → Mixed/Unclear, leak plus visual praise; r5 may be Negative with an explicit sarcasm note or Mixed/Unclear if uncertain. Either needs evidence, not an invented emotion.

steps.title: Define labels
steps.text: Write decision rules and an uncertainty route before testing.

steps.title: Make reference labels
steps.text: Label the five reviews yourself and note where a reasonable reviewer might disagree.

steps.title: Run the classifier
steps.text: Keep review IDs and exact quoted evidence for each output.

steps.title: Compare mistakes
steps.text: Count clear matches separately from ambiguous cases. Inspect r4 and r5 rather than hiding them.

steps.title: Test a new case
steps.text: Use “Fast delivery, broken item.” Decide whether the revised rules preserve both pieces of feedback.

checks: Every output preserves the review ID and quotes an actual evidence span.
Topic/issue is separate from sentiment, and the mixed review is not flattened into only praise.
Ambiguous labels and disagreements remain visible in the score table.
commonMistakes: Inferring a customer’s personality from a short comment.
offline: Use a manual sorting table and compare two readers’ labels before agreeing the policy.
reflection: Which review made a three-bucket classification inadequate?

evidence.title: Keep the build
evidence.detail: Save your original input, exact prompt and resulting artifact. Every output preserves the review ID and quotes an actual evidence span.

evidence.title: Show what you tested
evidence.detail: Record a pass/fail result and evidence for every check below. Topic/issue is separate from sentiment, and the mixed review is not flattened into only praise.

evidence.title: Explain a limitation
evidence.detail: Write what changed after one deliberate revision and name a remaining failure mode. Treating sarcasm detection as certain.
